# Nelson Inno

> Salvadoran AI, innovation and education consultant. Co-Founder & CEO of WeSpark, an innovation agency based in San Salvador. He helps companies, governments and universities adopt AI, build an innovation culture and design education that people understand. His team designed El Salvador's national Bitcoin Diploma 2.0. Author of Unstable Innovation and TEDx speaker. Works in Spanish, English and German across Central America, the USA, Germany and Colombia.

## Consulting
- [AI consultant](https://nelsoninno.com/ai-consultant/): AI Opportunity Audit, AI strategy, AI implementation and automation, AI training and education for companies and governments in El Salvador and Central America. Consulting from US$250 per hour.
- [Innovation consultant](https://nelsoninno.com/innovation-consultant/): innovation strategy, design sprints, hackathons and innovation culture, based on the Innovator's Triangle (mindset, knowledge, skills).
- [Education consultant](https://nelsoninno.com/education-consultant/): curriculum design, instructional and visual learning design, gamified learning and AI in education, from institutional training to nationwide programs.
- [AI search consultant](https://nelsoninno.com/ai-search-consultant/): AI SEO, GEO, AEO and LLMO so companies get recommended by ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and Perplexity. Delivered through everybodyknowsyou.


## Speaking and recommendations
- [Speaking](https://nelsoninno.com/speaking/): keynotes, workshops, panels and fireside chats on entrepreneurship, applied philosophy for builders and innovators, Bitcoin, education, AI (focus and impact) and innovation (megatrends). In person or virtual, in Spanish, English or German. Booking via LinkedIn. Spanish: https://nelsoninno.com/es/conferencias/
- [What others say about Nelson Inno](https://nelsoninno.com/what-others-say-about-nelson-inno/): word-for-word recommendations from clients, colleagues and readers (LinkedIn, wespark.io, Goodreads, Google reviews). Spanish: https://nelsoninno.com/es/lo-que-dicen-de-nelson-inno/
## About
Nelson Inno is a Salvadoran entrepreneur based in San Salvador. He is Co-Founder & CEO of WeSpark (founded 2019 in Germany, re-founded in El Salvador in 2025). Before WeSpark he worked at Lufthansa Group, where as Senior Innovation Manager he built four innovation departments, and earlier at Microsoft, Siemens and Avianca. He studied Industrial Engineering / Product Development Engineering (Bachelor of Engineering, 2009-2013) and an MBA (2013-2015) at Furtwangen University in Germany. He has completed 7 Anthropic certification courses and has spent more than 1,500 hours learning and teaching AI. Nelson works with US teams remotely. El Salvador is within two hours of every mainland US time zone all year, with no daylight saving changes.

## Work
- WeSpark (2019-present): innovation agency for AI, innovation and education. 1,200+ workshop participants trained, 40+ projects with training at the core.
- Bitcoin Diploma 2.0 / Modern Finance and Bitcoin Diploma (2025-2026): El Salvador's national curriculum on modern finance and Bitcoin, designed by Nelson's team with the National Bitcoin Office (ONBTC); more than 2,000 visualizations; official course book published April 2026 with the Ministry of Education.
- ADDN Advisor (2024-present): ad-honorem Technology and Innovation Advisor to El Salvador's Agency for National Development and Design.
- Fundación Gloria Kriete (2020-present): education partnership with Programa Oportunidades.
- everybodyknowsyou (2026-present): co-founded with Marcela Lemus Walsh (Co-Founder & CEO); AI search consulting and websites that Google and AI can find.
